focus: Data visualization, statistics, statistical analysis, and reproducible scientific computing
title: Thinking in Supersteps: PageRank, Pregel, and Reliable Graph Computation
utility_use_case: A researcher has a CSV of paired sensor readings and wants a quick, repeatable first look at whether two measurements move together. They can select the predictor and response explicitly, retain the JSON output in an analysis workflow, and note how many rows were omitted. Like an iterative graph analysis, this is a computation whose interpretation depends on clear input and method choices. The correlation report remains descriptive: it does not test significance or establish causation.
